# ML stock tools — batch one

Shared native ML Studio editor/host wrapper for ML De-Esser, ML Meter and ML Pitch Shift. Separate modules in `plugins/ml-de-esser`, `plugins/ml-meter` and `plugins/ml-pitch-shift` provide linked CLAP entries and optional standalone CLAP/VST3 exports. The built-in picker requires no external files, download or scan. Main I/O is stereo, at 8–192 kHz.

## Processing and provenance

- **ML De-Esser:** reuses `os-dsp::debess::DeBess`, the existing Airwindows DeBess adaptation (Chris Johnson, MIT; `licenses/Airwindows-MIT.txt`). Amount, smoothed mix/output, removed-signal monitoring and an RMS reduction reading. Zero added latency. The existing port fixes Sharp, Depth and Filter at 0.5; this is not a claim to expose every upstream parameter. The built-in mixer de-esser is unchanged.
- **ML Meter:** uses the already-pinned `ebur128` 0.1.11 library (Jan Kokemüller, Sebastian Dröge, MIT). M/S/I and true peak use its fixed histogram history, not an unbounded queue. Adds a 400 ms rolling RMS/correlation window, peak holds and reset. Audio is untouched and latency is zero. Readings are published atomically at approximately 20 Hz. Loudness history resets on host reset or the Reset meters button; readings are session measurements, not project parameters. Non-finite upstream samples are excluded from measurement only. Integrated loudness uses the library's 0.1 LU histogram bins. This integration has synthetic calibration tests, not an independent EBU certification.
- **ML Pitch Shift:** uses existing `signalsmith-stretch` 0.1.3 (Colin Marc) and its pinned Signalsmith Stretch engine (Geraint Luff / Signalsmith Audio, MIT). ±24 semitones plus ±100 cents, Follow/Preserve formants, mix and output. Same-frame-count streaming, stereo phase-linked engine. Uses the default quality configuration; host latency is input_latency + output_latency, fixed for the sample rate. Dry path is delayed by the same amount; neutral pitch uses the exact delayed dry signal. Settings transitions use the engine's spectral interpolation and smoothed output/mix/neutral-path fades. This is a mixing effect, not a promise of low-latency vocal monitoring. Upstream formant preservation is exposed without claiming artifact-free extreme shifts.

Original licence texts are already in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt; no donor branding replaces the ML interface. This wrapper is GPL-3.0-or-later with the rest of ML Studio.

## Runtime and controls

Initialize allocates processing state. Processing uses fixed stack chunks and preallocated DSP state. Tests instrument Rust allocation during processing/reset; the C++ engine separately preallocates its processing buffers at configure and caps its processing scratch to that capacity. Parameter reads use the shared stock editor's nonblocking pending-edit mechanism. There are no worker threads, external communications or downloads in these plugins. Host PDC, project state and automation use the existing plugin interface. Reset clears audio/meter history. Settings > Visibility > Stock plugins > Advanced DSP controls hides the controls/readouts without changing audio.

`cargo test -p ml-tools-core --lib` verifies DSP, transparency, calibration, no Rust processing allocations, host latency/state, values and layouts. `ML_TOOLS_RENDER_DIR` enables actual editor renders at 100/150/200 percent without opening windows. Application test `ml_tools_batch_stock_picker_insert_and_reload` checks all three normal stock effect registrations and state reloads. User listening/GUI checks and native Mac/Linux builds remain necessary before a public release.
